statement.p: For each of the following, perform the indicated operations on the vectors
\vec a = 4\,\mathit{\vec j}+4\,\mathit{\vec k}, \vec b = 3\,\mathit{\vec i}+\,\mathit{\vec j}+4\,\mathit{\vec k}, \vec z = \,\mathit{\vec i}+\,\mathit{\vec j}.

static.solution:
(a) 4 \vec a + 2 \vec b = 4 (4\,\mathit{\vec j}+4\,\mathit{\vec k}) + 2 (3\,\mathit{\vec i}+\,\mathit{\vec j}+4\,\mathit{\vec k}) = 6\,\mathit{\vec i}+18\,\mathit{\vec j}+24\,\mathit{\vec k}.
(b) 5 \vec a + 3 \vec b - 5 \vec z = 5 (4\,\mathit{\vec j}+4\,\mathit{\vec k}) + 3 (3\,\mathit{\vec i}+\,\mathit{\vec j}+4\,\mathit{\vec k}) - 5 (\,\mathit{\vec i}+\,\mathit{\vec j}) = 4\,\mathit{\vec i}+18\,\mathit{\vec j}+32\,\mathit{\vec k}.
